opening.title: Opening your payment
opening.lead: One moment while we look up the plan for your workspace.

summary.rateSettled: Converted at {rate} ILS per USD, the rate applied to this payment.
summary.rateIndicative: Your card is charged in shekels, at {rate} ILS per USD.
summary.activation: Your workspace opens fully once payment is confirmed.

paymentRequired.title: One step left
paymentRequired.lead: Set up payment to activate the plan chosen for your workspace.
paymentRequired.startFailed: We couldn't open the payment page. Try again in a moment.
paymentRequired.notYet: Secure payment isn't available yet. We'll be in touch as soon as it is, and nothing has been charged.

declined.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The payment was declined for insufficient funds.
declined.DECLINED: The card issuer declined the payment.

held.why: Billing in this environment uses the live payment account, so no payment is started from here.

processing.title: Confirming your payment
processing.lead: This usually takes a few moments. You can leave this page open.

manualReview.title: We're checking one thing
manualReview.lead: Your payment needs a quick manual check before your plan activates. You don't need to do anything else.

unresolved.title: We're checking with your bank
unresolved.lead: Your payment is being confirmed with the card issuer. This can take longer than usual, and you don't need to wait here: we'll email you as soon as we know. Please don't pay again in the meantime.

completed.title: Your plan is active
completed.lead: Payment is confirmed and your workspace is ready.
completed.resent: Sent. Check your inbox again in a moment.
completed.resendFailed: We couldn't send it just now. Try again in a moment.

failed.title: That payment didn't go through
failed.lead: No charge was made. You can try again, or contact us and we'll sort it out with you.

cancelled.title: You closed the payment page
cancelled.lead: Nothing was charged and no card was saved. Your plan is still waiting, and you can pick up where you left off whenever you're ready.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.lead: For security, payment links are valid for a limited time. Ask your admin for a new one, or contact us.

unavailable.title: We couldn't open this page
unavailable.lead: This link may have expired or already been used. Ask your admin for a new one, or contact us.
